name: cxDiscovery
oneLiner: Personalised inflight e-magazine plus vendor targeting.
reconnectTakeaway: State a second beneficiary (desk throughput), not only passenger care.

name: TouchCX
oneLiner: Passenger phone to crew tablet for amenity requests (NFC).
reconnectTakeaway: Win by sitting on a crew/agent device, not another passenger super-app.

name: Fight4Flight
oneLiner: Delay notification and re-planning from the passenger side.
reconnectTakeaway: Passenger-only re-plan loses. The desk is the missing 2017 piece.

name: Aviator
oneLiner: Dining and activity manager aimed at connecting passengers.
reconnectTakeaway: Connecting passengers are the moment; recovery is the job.

name: GME / Asia Miles visualiser
oneLiner: Map and proximity for Asia Miles partners, plus redemption notices.
reconnectTakeaway: A visual of a real Cathay ledger (queue, slack) beats a generic dashboard.

name: Cathay Green
oneLiner: Currency and AI to promote carbon offset and green practice.
reconnectTakeaway: Only claim sustainability if we can count fewer stranded hotel nights. Do not fake it.

name: NAAR cargo dimensioning
oneLiner: Computer vision to size cargo and pack denser, with less manual labour.
reconnectTakeaway: Lead with a number (minutes, pax, queue length). NAAR led with accuracy and labour.

name: GingTrip modular trolley
oneLiner: Modular galley trolley that sorts cabin waste and feeds a dashboard.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not add a robot. Do make the typhoon click as tactile as a trolley.

name: U-Explore (Kairos Takeoff Crew)
oneLiner: All-in-one HK Express customer-journey platform: loyalty, community, gamified content.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not copy the loyalty app. Copy the named BU and the lived pain sentence.

name: Niki Jr.
oneLiner: Polaroid robot named after CX DC-3 Niki; app booking, crowd-aware queueing.
reconnectTakeaway: Presentation award is theater. We already have buttons; narrate them.

name: FlyLab pre-flight briefings
oneLiner: AI summaries of existing pre-flight briefing packs for pilots.
reconnectTakeaway: Closest 2025 analogue. Pair with a transfer agent. Do not invent a new PSS.

name: Anita chatbot
oneLiner: Chatbot that reminds passengers before boarding.
reconnectTakeaway: Notify is not recover. We notify after an agent approves a protected flight.

name: Lugless
oneLiner: Bags packed and waiting at destination.
reconnectTakeaway: Bags are out of SCOPE. Do not add them before Saturday.

name: Cathay-Cargo box sequencing
oneLiner: Python to sequence boxes; CV sizing; zip of UI. NAAR-adjacent, not the champion repo.
reconnectTakeaway: Participant GitHub is not how NAAR won. Do not chase stars.

name: CathayConnect
oneLiner: Azure OpenAI trip planner. README includes the full pitch script.
reconnectTakeaway: Steal the habit of a written pitch. Do not steal the ChatGPT planner.

name: ReservaCathay
oneLiner: ML overbooking plus GPT-personalised compensation offers.
reconnectTakeaway: Use this as the foil when a judge asks why we did not put GPT on ranking.

name: Flymate
oneLiner: Flutter app for travellers with disabilities: documents, stays, needs.
reconnectTakeaway: Wheelchair +15 min is already in mct.ts. Say it out loud.

name: Syd (ctrl+shift+elite)
oneLiner: React + OpenAI + DialogFlow travel buddy chatbot.
reconnectTakeaway: This is what 2026 BU judges are tired of.

name: TravelSync
oneLiner: Vue app: chat, hotels, airport transfer, Splitwise.
reconnectTakeaway: Do not add hotels to the Saturday demo.

name: PassportScanner
oneLiner: Scan passport to auto-fill online check-in. Pain: <30% online check-in.
reconnectTakeaway: A number in the pitch is good. PNR in LLM prompts is already constrained in the pilot note.

name: Carbon per passenger model
oneLiner: ML for carbon emissions per passenger per flight.
reconnectTakeaway: Theme-chasing without a desk owner is 2022, not 2026.

name: Optimal flight route (2025 repo)
oneLiner: Public 2025 repo: most optimal flight route. Not the student champion.
reconnectTakeaway: Search GitHub for 2025 and you will not find Kairos. That is the point.

name: Amadeus Passenger Recovery
oneLiner: Mass reaccom: >50 flights and 8,000 pax in 40 minutes. CX live since ~2018 with Accenture chatbots and 15below.
reconnectTakeaway: Pitch beside this tool. Never instead.

name: CX typhoon programme (Rogers 2019)
oneLiner: Josh Rogers: 100,000 customers when the hub closes; wanted airborne reprotect on inflight Wi-Fi.
reconnectTakeaway: Our CX254 +180 demo is the 2019 wish, on a desk iPad.

name: United ConnectionSaver
oneLiner: Holds the outbound using walk time; SMS with minutes. 3.3 million connections saved since 2019.
reconnectTakeaway: Encode walk + WCH + UM now. Hold-the-flight is LATER. Know the map.

name: NASA Open MCT
oneLiner: Web mission-control glass: telemetry, timeline, mobile, one place.
reconnectTakeaway: Queue + connection + action drawer is already one glass. Say mission control, not dashboard.

name: SpaceX flight software culture
oneLiner: Control cycle on a clock; config DSL for non-software engineers; sim + HITL; no LLM in the loop.
reconnectTakeaway: packages/engine is already this shape. Pitch it that way.

name: amadeus-disruption-agent
oneLiner: LangGraph + Amadeus APIs. LLM phrases verified facts only. RAG for EU261.
reconnectTakeaway: Cite reasoning[] the way they cite policy passages.

name: AutoRescue
oneLiner: AWS Bedrock + Amadeus search for cancelled-flight rebooking.
reconnectTakeaway: Live Amadeus is impressive. Decision authority is not transferable to Saturday.

name: HKG A-CDM
oneLiner: TOBT/TSAT shared clock for turnaround. Missing passenger is an A-CDM delay reason.
reconnectTakeaway: Never use the iPad wall clock. FIDS eventTime / sim clock only.

name: Reconnect (this repo)
oneLiner: Deterministic MCT engine + iPad triage + guarded draft. Pilot: Altéa read, FIDS MQTT, CANS push.
reconnectTakeaway: The product is already the 2026 feasibility shape. The pitch must not throw it away.

name: Accenture Rebooking Experience
oneLiner: CX self-rebook chatbots in the typhoon stack: notify, then four steps to pick a preferred flight.
reconnectTakeaway: Chatbot self-rebook is already bought. Our send is agent-approved CANS, not a second bot.

name: 15below customer communication
oneLiner: Notification layer on CX disruption: once a new journey is accepted, 15below sends the new flight details.
reconnectTakeaway: CANS after human confirm sits beside 15below, not over it. Do not pitch a new notification platform.
